title: Eggs Now Cost More Than Milk. Seriously.
hook: Eggs just passed milk in price.
source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI Average Price Data, Eggs (Grade A, large, per dozen) and Milk (fresh, whole, fortified, per gallon), U.S. city average, 2019-2025; egg price spikes tied to avian-influenza outbreaks in commercial flocks per USDA APHIS reporting. 2025 figure is a partial-year average. Values shown in cents for both units.
